title: Appeal timing and consecutive tax clearance
topic: tax credit lots period eligibility refund cash liquidity appeal deadline
content: The schedule publishes the supported appeal range, while the chosen appeal channel determines fee and delay from application. Its actual additional award can change the remaining later-period payment or refundable balance. Current and following tax periods have separate deadlines and a shared original account. A current-period offset ceiling limits how much credit can replace that period’s cash payment. The original clearance-notice process applies to the current period after its actual cash and offset components post; final completion also requires the following period cleared and every elected cash refund actually received. All territories and rules in this schedule are fictional product terms.

provenance.scope: Fictional authority credit scopes, appeal guarantees and timing, not real tax law.
